evidence.text_en: A composer may add notes that a singer can select freely instead of the notated melody. The small notes added to the score are an alternative (optional) that allows singers who find it difficult to move toward a very high note to finish on a relatively lower note. When choosing the optional, it is good to sing with a somewhat more appealing sound, providing a sufficient reason for taking the alternative.
